title: Key lemma: for Lebesgue-a.e. frame the cone trichotomy holds at Hⁿ-a.e. point (Mattila Ch. 18; Dall'Alba Lemma 5.6, transferred to frames)
statement: Let n ≥ 1, ℓ ≥ 1, N := n + ℓ, A ⊆ ℝ^N compact with Hⁿ(A) < ∞ and δ > 0. For a linear map p : ℝ^N → ℝ^N and a ∈ ℝ^N let X_p(a, r, s) := {x : |p(x − a)| < s|x − a|} ∩ B(a, r), and say that T(a, p) holds if (Φ0) for every c > 0 there is ε > 0 with Hⁿ(A ∩ X_p(a, r, s)) ≤ c(rs)ⁿ for all 0 < s < ε, 0 < r < δ; or (Φ∞) for every K ∈ ℝ and ε > 0 there are 0 < s < ε, 0 < r < δ with K(rs)ⁿ ≤ Hⁿ(A ∩ X_p(a, r, s)); or (Ax) some b ∈ A has b ≠ a, |b − a| < δ and p(b − a) = 0. Then for Lebesgue-a.e. v ∈ (ℝ^N)ⁿ, if v is linearly independent, Hⁿ({a ∈ A : not T(a, frameProjection v)}) = 0, where frameProjection v is the orthogonal projection onto span v; i.e. ForAlmostAllProjections N n (fun p ↦ Hⁿ{a ∈ A : ¬T(a, p)} = 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < ℓ → ∀ A : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), IsCompact A → μHE[n] A < ∞ → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ForAlmostAllProjections (n + ℓ) n (fun p ↦ μHE[n] {a | a ∈ A ∧ ¬ ((∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < ε → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < δ → μHE[n] (A ∩ ({x | ‖p (x - a)‖ < s * ‖x - a‖} ∩ Metric.ball a r)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (r * s) ^ n)) ∨ (∀ K : ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s < ε ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < δ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (K * (r * s) ^ n) ≤ μHE[n] (A ∩ ({x | ‖p (x - a)‖ < s * ‖x - a‖} ∩ Metric.ball a r))) ∨ ∃ b ∈ A, b ≠ a ∧ dist b a < δ ∧ p (b - a) = 0)} = 0)
